strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚,{NEWLINE}电话坏了吗？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打试试！
strings.en: Um, ’scuse me? I can’t hear you very{NEWLINE}well. We must have a bad connection.{SCROLL}Try calling again from somewhere else!

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}最近怎么样？{CLEAR}我可是超级开心啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello...{NEWLINE}Um, hey, what’s up?{CLEAR}I’m doing great over here...totally!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这世上除了我,{NEWLINE}还有很多的优秀馆主,{CLEAR}你还要继续锻炼啊。
strings.en: There are lots of other awesome{NEWLINE}Gym Leaders out there besides me,{CLEAR}so you’ve gotta keep training!

strings.zh: 我在星期六的白天都很闲,{CLEAR}到时候给我打电话啊。
strings.en: I’m pretty free during the day on{NEWLINE}Saturdays. Give me a call then, OK?
strings.notes: US 0644/4 | RV070: meaning: zh: Saturday daytime; US noon (D-1894)

strings.zh: 啊~我现在无聊死了！{NEWLINE}对了！{CLEAR}和我再来打一场吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Yeah, I’m bored! Nothing to do!{NEWLINE}Oh, yeah!{CLEAR}You wanna battle me again? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 一定要来啊！{NEWLINE}我现在充满了干劲,{SCROLL}我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！
strings.en: For sure! I’m totally pumped now!{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting for you at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: US 0644/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 啊呀？{NEWLINE}你有时间和我战斗了？{SCROLL}跟别人约好的事{NEWLINE}随便失约不太好吧。
strings.en: Um, really?{NEWLINE}You really have time to battle me?{SCROLL}Don’t break a promise you made to{NEWLINE}someone else--that’s not fair!

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你,{CLEAR}不准失约啊。
strings.en: I’ll be waiting for you at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier.{CLEAR}Don’t you dare stand me up!
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.en: Um, this is Whitney.{NEWLINE}How are you?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你忘了我们在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋{CLEAR}对战的约定了？{CLEAR}真是的。
strings.en: Did you forget our promise to{NEWLINE}battle at the Trainer House{CLEAR}at the Battle Frontier? Jeez.
strings.notes: US 0644/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: ３９号道路的{NEWLINE}哞哞牧场你去过吗？{SCROLL}我的小奶罐⋯⋯{NEWLINE}大奶罐就在那里长大的。
strings.en: Um, have you ever been to{NEWLINE}MooMoo Farm on Route 39?{SCROLL}My Milky... Um, I mean, my{NEWLINE}Miltank grew up there.

strings.zh: 你有没有觉得{NEWLINE}不知不觉就肚子饿了？{SCROLL}别说什么吃太多了！{NEWLINE}我这年纪这样很正常的！
strings.en: Um, I’ve gotta tell you, I’m so{NEWLINE}hungry... Do you know how it feels?{SCROLL}I’m not an overeater or anything! This{NEWLINE}is completely normal for my age!

strings.zh: 四天王中最帅的当属⋯⋯{CLEAR}志霸？{SCROLL}不仅是我,{NEWLINE}所有人都是这么认为的。{CLEAR}强壮的男人最帅了。
strings.en: The coolest member of the Elite Four?{NEWLINE}Umm... I’d have to say... Bruno?{SCROLL}And it’s not just me. Everybody thinks{NEWLINE}so. Strong guys are the coolest!
